answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, underpinned by a verifiable delay function constructed from a sequential delay cipher, which leverages quartz-like hardness assumptions to ensure computational infeasibility of identity cloning; the spiral structure of our protocol's reputation graph, combined with information-theoretic unforgeability, guarantees that any attempt at cloning will result in a detectable anomaly, thereby ensuring cryptographic finality and Byzantine fault tolerance.
